name: persistence
title: OS-PERSIST2: change a MUTE MODE and a PERFORM scene, SAVE AS the automatic name Track NN (writes the card), put the state back, open the project from File (the newest of the RECENT group), the values are back; the scratch project is hidden by DELETE at the end (its folder stays on the card)

steps.say: a card is in the unit, not write protected (any SD card; --expect-volume is optional), or nothing below runs

steps.note: (Shift released, in case a former run left it down)
(a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
(the cpu counters are since boot or since this reset: a scenario that checks underruns / over-budget starts from zero)

steps.say: 1. a MUTE MODE: the TRACKS layer (Shift held), row 3 of the pads, track 3; the pads' lights change

steps.note: MUTE MODE of track 3

steps.say: 2. a PERFORM scene: RESET, slot 1 row 1 on, F1 held 1.3 s stores scene 1
3. SAVE AS: File F5 opens the keyboard on the first free 'Track NN'; F1 accepts that name (nothing to run out of)

steps.note: (Shift + Fx says FILL / EXPORT: NOT YET: the last message is a known one, not an old SAVE ... DONE)
(the File screen keeps its page when it is left, EXPORT after qa_wavexp: F6 twice ends on PROJECTS from EXPORT or PROJECTS; steps 5 and 7 below find the page as it is left here)
F1 accepts the proposed name (F8 would cancel; OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)

the project's own save job is through (the SAVE_INSTRnn_DONE messages are the samples', one each, and come first; an Open before the end aborts the save); its NN is kept as {{SAVED}} for the DELETE guard of step 7

steps.say: 4. put the runtime state back to what the file does NOT have: mute mode of track 3, scene slot
5. open the saved project from File: it is the newest of the RECENT group, the first row after a RESCAN; F1 opens the project under the cursor

steps.note: RESCAN
the cursor to the first entry
the first row is the Track NN saved in step 3 ({{SAVED}}), not any Track NN (if not, the RECENT group is not first or another project is newer: nothing is opened)
(only when the strip asks: the state put back counts as a change, and this open is meant to discard it)
the project just saved ({{SAVED}}) is opening
(the load line says `N values reset` when a chunk had values out of range)
QA-FIL-095 (OS-OPENTOPAT): a project that opened shows the Pattern view by itself
(already there since OS-OPENTOPAT; the Pattern button on its own screen changes nothing)

steps.say: 6. the saved values are back: the lights are not the ones of the state put back

steps.note: MUTE MODE of track 3 is back (the layer's row 3 differs from the state put back)
the scene's slot FX is not in the lights, but scene recall is: F1 recalls it
scene 1 is stored in the loaded project (an empty scene says SCENE IS EMPTY)
the recalled scene lights its slot

steps.say: 7. hide the scratch project (the OS has no erase: DELETE writes an empty .deleted in the folder and the File list stops showing it). It is the open project, which DELETE refuses, so t-v16 is loaded first. Every press is guarded by `sel`, the name under the cursor, and the second Delete by the question in the strip: both must name the Track NN saved in step 3 ({{SAVED}}), nothing else can be hidden

steps.note: RESCAN
the cursor to the first entry
(t-v16 may be the newest row: one Down to the project just saved, at most two)
(soft: the cursor is on the Track NN saved in step 3; if not, nothing below presses Delete)
the question
the second press marks it deleted (sent only while the strip shows the question for the project just saved)
(soft: the project is hidden; if not, the Track NN folder stays listed)

finally.note: (a leftover overlay is put away: F8 is BACK on the Navigator, the keyboard (cancel, never accept: F1 accepts) and the choosers, OS-UXF-KEYS item 5)
